parsed.summary: The PR replaces the use of a temporary .pgpass file with the PGPASSWORD environment variable in the PostgreSQL client. It also adds new test files for the changes.

issues.description: The code style is inconsistent with the rest of the repository, such as the removal of the blank line after the import statements and the addition of unnecessary blank lines.
The PR does not include any documentation updates for the changes made.
